nodes.title: Gate scheduling and action planning
nodes.publicInputHint: GateSchedule mode:reversible_permutation accepts state:[labels], goal:[labels], operators:[{id,permutation:[destinationIndexForEachSourceSlot]}], maxDepth and maxStates. It plans only under those supplied public bijections, returns a verified path or bounded-search unknown. GateSchedule additionally supports mode:grid_push with grid:[equal-width strings], glyphs:{wall,floor,box,goal,player,boxOnGoal?,playerOnGoal?} (each is the public character or set of characters), goalMode:consume|occupy, budget. Use ONLY if native public rules define an orthogonal push-only grid. It computes a full native-direction plan and rejects deadlock pushes using supplied geometry; inspect each successor. Unknown cells stay blocked. The original GateSchedule/returnViability modes apply ONLY to a public two-track gate model. config={length,aGates,bGates,aCargo,bCargo}, state={a,b,pa,pb}, proposed={da,db}, budget is remaining public actions. Do not pretend that chess or continuous physics uses this transition model.
